title: Ireland Work Permit Pakistan — Requirements, Fees & Process | SK Immigration
description: Ireland work permit / work visa from Pakistan: requirements, documents, fees, timeline, mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: How to get a Ireland work permit from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: You typically need a genuine Ireland job offer/authorization, then a complete national visa file. SK Immigration prepares the Pakistan-side documents from PKR 80,000; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Ireland work visa?
faqs.answer: Passport, contract/authorization, CV, certificates, and any medical/police documents requested. Exact lists vary — we build a checklist for your case.

faqs.question: SK Immigration Ireland work fee?
faqs.answer: From PKR 80,000 for preparation support. Official fees are separate. No guarantees.

faqs.question: Do I need local language for Ireland?
faqs.answer: Often helpful; some international roles use English. We assess language before you invest.

faqs.question: Can I convert a visit visa to work in Ireland?
faqs.answer: Not as a DIY loophole. Work needs the correct authorization. We advise legal routes only.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. Immigration authorities decide every application.

Ireland work permit / work visa from Pakistan

Ireland work is regulated: the permit type must match the occupation and salary. We do not invent sponsorships.

Requirements

  • Eligible Irish job offer
  • Correct employment permit category
  • Passport and identity docs
  • Qualifications matching the role
  • English evidence where required

Process

  1. Permit pathway review
  2. Document packaging
  3. Application sequencing
  4. Entry / residence steps briefing

Documents

  • Passport
  • Offer / permit docs
  • Degrees and experience letters
  • Police / medical if requested

Checklist tool: Open checklist →

Fees

SK from PKR 80,000. Government fees separate.

Timeline

Often several months depending on permit type.

Common mistakes

  • Wrong permit category
  • Salary below thresholds
